title: State-resolved quantum transport of vortex electrons in accelerators
summary: Vortex electrons carry a quantized orbital angular momentum (OAM) degree of freedom, but whether this internal structure can survive repeated transport through an accelerator lattice remains unclear. Here we formulate a density-matrix theory for periodic round lattices and show that the symmetry-protected quantity is a Lewis-Floquet OAM invariant, rather than the instantaneous kinetic OAM. The classical transfer map lifts to unitary state evolution, while stochastic field errors generate a Lindblad channel. This framework exposes a sharp separation between visibility and state survival.…
